values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: Deep space hit
values.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TARGET] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TARGET] around [LOCATION]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

values.title: Trainee Rank - Direct Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]

values.title: Verified Freelancer Bounty Reassessment
values.description:
Good news! Crusader Security has decided to offer you another chance at being a bounty contractor. We are hoping that during this time you have corrected any past performance issues and can once again be a useful asset.

First though, we are required to reevaluate you, and as such, would like you to complete this bounty contract for [TargetName].

Upon the successful completion of this trial, you'll be restored to Crusader's Verified Freelancer list and be eligible for any future bounty collection work as it becomes available.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

values.title: Deal with [TARGET] and Support Forces
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. [TARGET] and their crew were identified executing a raid on [LOCATION]. If their MO holds true, [TARGET] has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again.

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of [TARGET] difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force [TARGET] to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: [DESTINATION] Stroll
values.description:
Any chance you’re at [DESTINATION]?

Need a box hustled from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.

-Smokey

values.title: Getting To the Bottom of It
values.description:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION] and take it to [DESTINATION]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Red Wind Local Shipment Route
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

There’s a sizeable allotment of packages that need to be taken to the [Dropoff1] at [Dropoff1|Address]. As long as your ship has enough room, this should be a relatively simple run.

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
· Package #[Item1|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup1|Address]
· Package #[Item2|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup2|Address]
· Package #[Item3|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup3|Address]
· Package #[Item4|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup4|Address]
· Package #[Item5|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup5|Address]
· Package #[Item6|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup5|Address]
· Package #[Item7|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup6|Address]
· Package #[Item8|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup6|Address]
· Package #[Item9|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup7|Address]
· Package #[Item10|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup7|Address]

DROP OFF LOCATION
· All Packages delivered to the [Dropoff1] at [Dropoff1|Address]

DO NOT TAKE THIS CONTRACT - unless you are reliable. Red Wind has a reputation that our clients trust and for good reason.

values.title: Getting Our Gear Back
values.description:
If you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself. That's what they say, right? Wish I had the time for that, but I have a business to run.

Some of our goods have been mislaid and I need a contractor to put this right for me. Got some info that the guys at [LOCATION] ghosted one of my gang and got their hands on our gear. I need you to grab the stuff, deal with anyone at the location and take it to the drop-off at [DESTINATION] for me. Get it done and I'll sort out your payment.

-Twitch

values.title: Member Rank - Direct Medium Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]

values.title: [Contractor|AssassinSyncTitle]
values.description: [Contractor|AssassinSyncDescription]

values.title: Red Level Contract: Ship Under Attack
values.description:
An emergency contract just came in about a fight near [LOCATION]. Apparently a group of ships were ambushed by outlaws led by [TARGET], who's been wanted on multiple planets for murder and ship theft. Foxwell's looking for top tier combat pilots to go and protect the clients against them.

This one's been flagged as a red level contract so it's really dangerous. If you have people you could bring, you probably should. If you do, you should also let them know about Foxwell's hiring policies.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
values.description:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a handheld tractor beam.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Back up needed at outpost
values.description:
Those XenoThreat punks launched an attack against [LOCATION] so we're looking for people to go fend them off.

Get out there and waste every XenoThreat you see.

Stows out.

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: Find Missing Cargo Hauler
values.description:
Hey,

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TargetName] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [Location|Address], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TargetName] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [Destination|Address]. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: [Title] ([Item])
values.description: [Description]

values.title: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
values.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at [LOCATION] our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation.

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Active Bounty Evaluation
values.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is in need of new qualified bounty hunters to expand our existing roster. To evaluate your skills, we would like you to assist us in the apprehension of [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

While there will be other criminals at the site, your main focus should be on completing the bounty.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

values.title: Away From Prying Eyes
values.description:
I told the Nine Tails that blocking quantum travel to hold a whole area hostage was gonna attract the wrong kind of attention, but do they listen to me? No. Now Crusader’s got dozens of scanning ships out there poking their noses into things I’d rather stay hidden.

That’s why I'm trying to hire as many people as I can to help me out. I wanna pay you for each Crusader scanning ship you take out.

In fact, I’ll even up your rate per-ship if all of you hit a certain number of kills. Call it a performance incentive.

And if you're really feeling like an overachiever, take out any fools brave enough to try running cargo to the blockaded station. I've got some suppliers who'll be appreciative of the extra demand.

values.title: Need Resource for Research
values.description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

values.title: Missing: [TargetName]
values.description:
Junior surveyor [TargetName] fell out of contact with their team while identifying potentially viable mineral seams in a cave near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. Wild animals have been known to frequent this location, which has led Citizens for Prosperity to believe that the surveyor may have been attacked while on the job and is currently stranded.

We need someone to find them and render aid if at all possible. If it's too late and they're beyond help, it will at least comfort the rest of the team to know what happened to their friend.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Lrg. Purchase Order: Hand Mined Materials
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[LOCATION]

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Oust Claimjumpers
values.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary
LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*:
A local Stanton independent mining team was working [Location] as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to [Location], destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Verify Deceased Criminal: [TARGET]
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP70001
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
In need of a highly competent operator for a special assignment. A highly dangerous outlaw that has been evading local authorities for some time has been reported to have been involved in a large-scale ship battle, resulting in their supposed death. Our client wishes to confirm that they have been neutralized.

Contract Investigator Actions:
We require you to head to [LOCATION] locate [TARGET]’s body and confirm their death.

Additional Notes:
Serious preparation is advised for this contract as there is a strong potential for there to be highly aggressive and dangerous hostiles still on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bring other skilled pilots with you.

values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: Getting What They Deserve
values.description:
I got a situation I need dealing with pronto. A rival crew has intercepted a major shipment of gear I was expecting and all hell is breaking loose. The pilot’s ghosted, the ship’s busted, and it’s only a matter of time before they take my shit and leave. If you’re up for cracking these assholes, head to [LOCATION] and get my five packages.

Head’s up though, the pilot they ghosted was one of my best, so this crew’s got to be seriously kitted out. Bring your finest mates with you and show the bastards no mercy. Understood?

When you’re done, take the gear to [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a serious cut of the takings.

-Twitch

values.title: Kill Order: "Citizens" at [location]
values.description:
The group of instigators that calls itself “Citizens for Prosperity” can no longer be allowed to continue spreading their lies and propaganda without repercussion.

As a sharp reminder of who really controls Pyro we have issued a kill order to eradicate all “Citizen” presence at [location|address]. Resistance is likely, but we expect you to handle it with little difficulty. Do as directed and you’ll be paid well for your work.

Comm. Spec. Engler

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_MultiToSingle]

values.title: Neutralize Dangerous Criminal Fleet
values.description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Out of Resources – Large Resupply
values.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of resources is practically out of stock.

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to do a resupply run to [Destination|Address].

Up to you how you get the stuff. Mine it, steal it, buy it from a trader - I don’t care as long as I get what I need refined and delivered. Might be worth checking the asteroid clusters near LaGrange points to start.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

values.title: Help defend [LOCATION] from Headhunters
values.description:
We just received a frantic comm from [LOCATION] and are looking for any available combat specialists to help repel a Headhunter attack. There are still hostiles on site and there are reports of several casualties so we need this handled quickly.

I will provide all relevant data upon acceptance. Thank you for your assistance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_MultiToSingle]

values.title: Bleeding Edge Tech
values.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Trainee Rank - Direct Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]

values.title: Out of Salvage – Small Resupply
values.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash is practically out of stock.

That’s why you’re going to do a resupply run to [Destination|Address] and bring them the salvaged materials.

Scrap it yourself or take it off some unsuspecting scav. Should be able to find some wrecks orbiting around most planets. Your call. Either way, as soon as we get the supplies, we’ll put it to good use building back up everything we lost.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

values.title: [Contractor|AssassinationTitle]
values.description: [Contractor|AssassinationDescription]

values.title: Senior Rank - Medium Cargo Haul
values.description:
Greetings,

Seems like [LOCATION] currently has some 16 SCU or smaller cargo that needs to be separated and delivered to a few different spots.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION2]

Drop-offs can be done in whatever order works best for you.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

[SIGN_OFF]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Wikelo Arrive to System
values.description:
Hello, I am Wikelo. Recent addition to your system and very excited to be here. Spent many time here in UEE and happy to spent more.

Have place where I make things from other things.

Need person to bring me useful things to finish project I work on. You have list. Get, please. I am at [DESTINATIONS].

Will give you item for your help.

Also, when done, if you want to do more. Have many things can make in my humble shop. Come, look at pretty poster and then decide what you want me to make.

Bye.

values.title: REFUEL REQUEST: [Ship]
values.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.

A beacon has just gone live at Asteroid Mining Base, from a client whose [Ship] is in need of [HydrogenFuel] SCU of Hydrogen Fuel, so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Alliance Aid: Collect Manufacturing Resource - Small Scale
values.description:
POSTING: Resource Gathering
LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System
WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*:
As a member of Alliance Aid, Shubin Interstellar is dedicated to assisting in the production of as many high quality ventilation filters as possible. These filters are key to stopping the spread of Molina Mold and keeping more people from being stricken with the People’s Ailment.

We’ve just received word from our facility at [DESTINATION] that their stockpile of a vital resource is getting low. Our normal supplier won’t be able to do a resupply run for a while, so we’re hoping you might be able to do a small scale run of it now to bridge the gap.

If you’re available, simply acquire it as you see best and bring it to our facility, and we’ll compensate you well.

Resources tied to another contract will not be accepted.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Major Malfunction
values.description:
I won’t go into the whole long boring story of why, but there are a few bits of [Location|Address] that we need destroyed. The important part is that I want to pay you a hefty chunk of credits to do it. I almost feel like you should be paying us for this because of how fun it’s going to be.

Don’t even care how you get it done. Grenades, rocket launcher, day old Torpedo Burrito, it’s all the same to us.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Investigate Wreckage Claim
values.description: [Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverDescription]

values.title: Special Recovery Operation
values.description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to [LOCATION] in order to take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Out of Detatrine – Medium Resupply
values.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock.

That’s why you and whoever else you want to bring along are going to do a detatrine resupply run to [Destination|Address].

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that depots across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

values.title: DEAD SAINTS - Rookie Rank - Medium Cargo Haul
values.description:
One of our best distributors got busted in Stanton so we need a replacement. The guy was an incredible salesman, but a shit smuggler. We need someone who won't run face-first into a security patrol or a pack of pirates to pick up some merchandise at these locations:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

And bring it all to [DESTINATION] before security catches on to what's happening. You'll need enough space on your ship for size 2 SCU containers, and a handheld tractor beam should make loading and unloading nice and easy.

-Twitch

values.title: Rookie Rank - Direct Extra Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hello,

Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 1 SCU in size.

Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?

[SIGN_OFF]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: [TargetName] Vanished
values.description:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to [TargetName]. Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to [Location|Address] and find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

values.title: Headhunter attack on [LOCATION]
values.description:
A distress call just came in from [LOCATION] claiming that a large Headhunter force has just attacked our outpost there. There have been multiple deaths and injuries from those who managed to flee the scene. We're looking for any available security personnel to head there and retake the outpost.

Witness accounts identified the attackers as elite Headhunter enforcers, so watch yourself out there and bring help if you can.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Rookie Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hi,

There’s a load of stims at [LOCATION] ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers 4 SCU or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me?

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]

Glad I never picked up the habit myself because I swear I get more delivery update requests for “where are my stims?!?” than any other kind of shipment.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Find XenoThreat Captives and Stolen Data
values.description:
A small group of Citizens for Prosperity members were supposed to be delivering sensitive data back to our headquarters in Stanton, but they never arrived.

We now believe that they were captured by XenoThreat before they could leave the system. I'd like you to investigate [Location|Address] to discover what happened to the missing crew and then destroy any servers they could be using to store the stolen data.

Your help is very appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Med. Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.

- Stows

values.title: Finish the job
values.description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at [LOCATION]. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a heavy-duty tractor beam and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

values.description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at [LOCATION] that have to be moved to [DESTINATION]. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t.

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a handheld tractor beam and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done.

Stows out.

values.description:
We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in [location|address]. We need you to clear ‘em out.

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

We're looking for contractors ready to take the fight to them.

They want us to believe that they have right on their side. They want us to believe that they have overwhelming force. This is a chance to show them we know better.

I won't lie, this is more than just a simple security contract to me. I really hate those intolerant assholes and everything they stand for.

You with me?

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing:
To prevent the Shattered Blade from flooding the black market with xeno-contraband, the UEE has charged InterSec with recovering a stash of Vanduul Plating and Metal. from the old QV Logistics station the gang has been occupying. Once you have the materials in your posession, deliver them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Following from your previous experience, it would not be surprising if the Shattered Blade offer resistance, but ensure that your focus is on recovering the materials.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin

values.title: Setting a Trap
values.description:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a[TARGET] and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that they fly by frequently.

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of 1 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

Stows out.

values.title: Overdrive Initiative: XENOTHREAT INCURSION
values.description:
Waves of XenoThreat ships have been pushing into Stanton system and attacking random civilians. We can't tell if this is an isolated attack or a reaction to our recent initiatives, but we need them stopped.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

values.title: Convince Upstarts to Abandon Sector
values.description:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named [TARGET] who is operating out of [LOCATION]. They've become a real concern for the Headhunters.

It's time to shut them down.

Head over, take out [TARGET] and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave.

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

values.title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
values.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.

A Club member has run out of [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST]. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their [SHIP] and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates.

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

If you’re available, I highly recommend that you bring additional combat support ships, plenty of supplies, and your A-game. Get this right, and we’ll reward the main contractor with a bonus payment of 9 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Write Off
values.description:
Not sure how the hell this happened, but my pilot’s gone and got themselves killed over at [LOCATION]. If you want to die on your own time, that’s your business, but they did it while carrying a stash for me. Now I gotta have someone go out there and finish their work.

Take the two packages to [DESTINATION] and I’ll have one of my crew collect it later. If you see those assholes who took out my pilot, give ‘em hell.

-Twitch

values.title: Special Purchase Order: Mined Materials
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [System]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.

Reminder, materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [Hint_Tool].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [Destination|Address].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: A Mother's Plea
values.description:
My son Nico was sadly among the victims of the tragic accident at Covelex's Gundo station and they still haven't returned all of his personal possessions to me. I understand that they have to do things according to regulations, but it seems unconscionable that they wouldn't make some allowances for the grieving family members. To that end, I'm seeking someone who will be able to go to the station for me. To be clear, Gundo is currently considered off limits, meaning that this would not be above board, but I feel my situation warrants special consideration. My sister says that the rate I am offering is the correct amount for retrieving the crate with Nico's belongings (#964) and bringing them to [Destination], so hopefully I can find a competent individual to settle this matter quickly.

Sincerely,
Gloria Theolone

values.title: Experienced Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement

values.description:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold 1 SCU cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you.

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of Quartz from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Covalex Shipping

values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.
You will be required to lift up to .25 SCU in weight.
Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Extensive Repairs Needed: Chawla's Beach
values.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at [LOCATION] suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Active Bounty: [TargetName] (VLRT)
values.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend the very low-risk target [TargetName] from [Location|Address].

A very low-risk target typically pilots a single seater craft, has few known allies, and should be relatively easy to apprehend.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Neutralize [TargetName]; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to vehicle suitably outfitted for combat.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

values.title: get the goods
values.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that a derelict outpost received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two.

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes.

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

values.title: Bounty Extraction: [TargetName] (MRT)
values.description: [Contractor|BountyDescription]

values.title: Patrol Dangerous Travel Lanes
values.description:
Outlaws have been increasing their activity along one of the more popular routes in the system and we’re hoping to provide a deterrent before the problem gets out of hand. As such, we’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and deal with any hostiles you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 8 MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: [Contractor|BaseSweepTitle]
values.description: [Contractor|BaseSweepDescription]

values.description: [InitiatorName] is requesting combat assistance in [InitiatorLocation]. If accepted, you will be paid [PaymentAmount] aUEC upon elimination of the threat.

values.title: Orison Relief: Small Fabrication Order
values.description:
Now then,

After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.

We've attached a blueprint for the TH-01 Propulsor that you can access at an Item Fabricator. Just search for it on the fabricator's terminal and you'll be able to see what materials are needed. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. (And if you don't have a fabricator yet, you'll have to purchase one at a shop, unload it at a freight elevator, and then set it up in a hangar or ship's cargo bay.)

Once you're done bring them to [DESTINATION] and one of the team will sort out the rest.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

The refinery at [LOCATION] has been busy. They’ve processed a mix of refined ores and are looking to get the containers (16 SCU or smaller) shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see where this stuff is needed and was able to put together this run.

values.title: Stop Gang From Destroying Fuel Tanks
values.description:
Got word from some allies of ours over at [LOCATION] that they're coming under attack. A gang we've had run-ins with before are trying to take them over by first destroying their [OBJECTS].

This crew are mungers through and through, but they mean business and can handle themselves in a fight. It will take a bit of doing to make sure they don't blow up everything. You might even think about bringing some help along.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor 6 Council Scrip.

- Stows

values.title: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at [LOCATION]
values.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: good help’s hard to find
values.description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at [Location|Address], but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

values.title: Find [TargetName] and Missing Supplies
values.description:
Hey,

Wondering if you can help me. I’ve lost touch with a dedicated CFP volunteer named [TargetName] who was tracking down supplies taken by XenoThreat. Their last comm said they believed our stuff was being held at [Location|Address]. I told them to be careful, but haven’t heard anything since.

Any chance you can head out and try to locate [TargetName|First]? While there, if you spot the supplies, please bring them to [Destination|Address]. I’ll give you the same warning I gave [TargetName|First], that spot is a known Xeno stronghold. Better be prepared. Would hate for you to disappear too after visiting that spot.

Be Safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

In relation to a jointly committed crime, a group warrant has been issued for:
[Target1]
[Target2]
[Target3]

It is currently believed that they are no longer traveling together in order to evade capture, and may soon flee the system. You should strongly consider recruiting additional help in order to execute all the warrants in the limited time frame.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the targets.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract when all targets have been dealt with in the allotted time.

This contract is non-negotiable.

values.title: Seeking Experienced Combat Pilots
values.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is in need of pilots with dogfighting experience. If you’re looking to put your skills to the test, I have a mission here for you to try.

A civilian ship has requested combat support near [LOCATION]. Head there and show us that you have the skills to excel in these types of missions and we’ll put you to good use.

Please be aware. This mission is not a training exercise. This is a real encounter, so please do your best to save the ship in distress.

Good Luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Scrap Salvage at [Location]
values.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at [Location|Address]. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds.

- Stows

values.title: Trigger A Trap
values.description:
Some asshole going by the name [TargetName] has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished.

I think [TargetName|Last] knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around [Location|Address]. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all.

- Smokey

values.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ship Under Attack
values.description:
Foxwell is looking for an available combat pilot to provide immediate assistance to a [SHIP] under attack over by [LOCATION]. We have not identified the perpetrators in the attack, but have been assured it is a small force.

Please dispatch quickly and clear out all hostiles. We need the client to make it through this as they haven't paid us yet.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

values.title: Fuel to the Fire
values.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that [location|address] is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high.

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

values.title: [Contractor|BountyTitle]
values.description: [Contractor|BountyDescription]

values.title: Scout and Scan
values.description:
Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go.

This one kicks off at the location marker on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.

Get this done and I'll toss the main contractor 4 Council Scrip as a thanks.

Stows out.

values.title: Keep [LOCATION] Safe
values.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that [LOCATION] is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their [OBJECTS]. It won't stand.

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including any friendly ships in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

Comm. Spec. Engler

values.description:

--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TargetName]
SYSTEM: [System]
RISK ASSESSMENT: Low
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [Location]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS:

values.description:

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at [LOCATION]. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

values.description:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to [Pickup1|Address]. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: #[Item1|SerialNumber].

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at [Dropoff1|Address].

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Braden Corchado

Northrock Service Group

values.description: [Description]

values.title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: [Ship]
values.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a [Ship] looking to be topped up with [FuelType] at Asteroid Mining Base. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen and [QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a handheld tractor beam and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done.

Stows out.

Hey,

Hope everything is going all right. I may have reached out already, but I wanted to be sure and introduce myself. I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system today, providing a variety of services to all major governmental bodies as well as various private concerns. The reason I am contacting you is because we believe someone with your skills could be a boon to our clients.

Not only that, but I think we'd be good fit for you. Our contractors traditionally get a higher rate of pay than a lot of our competitors in system, and a lot of them tell me how they really enjoy being tasked with the challenging and interesting work we offer.

Now, Northrock holds itself to such high-standards so before we can make anything official, you'll need to achieve approved contractor status by completing a pro tem contract.

I was hoping you could capture several wanted members of an outlaw gang: [Target1], [Target2], and [Target3].

Get that done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

Foxwell Enforcement

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

values.description:
A rather creative former contractor of ours with a knack for staging accidents was so swept up in their work that they forgot to confirm the death of [TARGET] for us.

The target’s body should be located at [LOCATION]. I need you to give the hopefully deceased an inspection to ensure the job was completed to our standard.

Do be careful when you arrive at the location. It wouldn’t surprise me if there was a few vultures lurking around.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

----------------------------

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Preemptive Strike
values.description:
Headhunters got word there’s a XenoThreat op in the works that's targeting one of our crews. We don’t have precise details about the plan but we know that [TargetName] is organizing it. Instead of sitting back and waiting for something to happen, we’ve decided to be proactive.

[TargetName|Last] was just spotted with others around [Location|Address]. We can’t mobilize anyone fast enough to get there. I want you to rush there and deliver a preemptive strike.

Stows out.

values.title: Hunt Some Heads
values.description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of 16 Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.

- Stows

values.title: Strategic Salvage Reserve – Small Resupply
values.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation.

To that end, we were hoping that you could resupply [Destination|Address] with salvaged materials. It would go a long way in helping us rebuild what was lost in the attacks.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to acquire what we need, but should be able to find some wrecks to scavenge orbiting around most planets.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Ripe for the Taking
values.description:
Got some good news for you. As we speak, there’s an automated facility that is churning out package after package of primo product that’s pretty much ripe for the taking.

All you have to do is swoop down there, deal with a thug or two, grab whatever you can, and sell it for a huge profit. Shouldn’t be a problem at all. And there are plenty of people around who would pay good creds to take product like that off your hands.

Speaking of credits, I’m not gonna just give out the coordinates of this facility out of the kindness of my heart. I think it’s only fair to ask a finder’s fee for info this good.

I wouldn’t wait too long. Not sure how long the site will be left running.

-Ruto

values.title: Track Down Spy
values.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on the head of [TargetName]. As a member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] hacked into XenoThreat systems to steal information on our operations and personnel. The harm done can only be rectified by ensuring [TargetName|Last] can never do something like this again. That’s why XenoThreat will pay anyone who can track down and assassinate [TargetName|Last].

LOCATION UPDATE: Recent scans identified [TargetName|Last] traveling with other ships near [Location|Address].

Comm. Spec. Engler

values.title: Bleeding Edge Tech
values.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-437 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Demolition Mission
values.description:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at Storehouse and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters.

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

values.title: Verified Bounty: [TARGET] at QV Breaker Station
values.description:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: Nyx
RISK ASSESSMENT: Medium
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: Claw Salamanders
NOTES: These old, abandoned QV Breaker Stations should be approached with caution. Not only are they are in a state of significant disrepair, but they are frequently inhabited by dangerous fauna and outlaws, like the target's associate gang members.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

values.title: Make ATLS shoot
values.description:
Hello. Know you human like strange metal suit. How about metal suit with ikti? Sorry, ikti is Banu word, you call it 'gun.'

If want, bring things I say and I will make for you. Gun will shoot. Cause many damage.

Bye.

values.title: Very Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
values.description:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: A Well Deserved Break
values.description:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TARGET] once and for all.

Start your search at [LOCATION]. These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.

However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn

values.title: Exterminate Eavesdroppers
values.description:
Some idiots think they can blatantly spy on the Headhunters and get away with it. They’ve set up several orbital sentries at [location|address] and have a few ships patrolling the area. We don’t know who’s behind it but we honestly don’t care. We just need it gone.

Let us know if you feel like putting some real brash bastards in their place. We’ll pay you well and deliver the creds the second the job is done.

Keep in mind that it’s really only the sentries we care about. The ships they got patrolling are only a concern if they get in your way or if they try to call in some friends to stop you.

Stows out.

values.title: Large Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
values.description:
Hi, it's El.

Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.

Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at [LOCATION] and bringing it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Really appreciate your help.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Should'a left it to a professional
values.description:
We had this kid named [TargetName] volunteer to go take out some XenoThreat near Remote Outpost near [NearbyLocation]. Everything we knew about the place said it was gonna be too much for [TargetName|Last] to handle, but they were real keen on boosting their standing with the Headhunters and thought this would do it, so they went alone.

Haven't heard anything but XenoThreat comms coming out of that place since. If you want to go and knock it over, we'll pay you instead. If you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last] that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

values.title: Silent Strike
values.description:
Any interest in taking out a [TARGET] for us?

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by [LOCATION] soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss 3 Council Scrip to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

values.title: A little retaliation
values.description:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [LOCATION] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

values.title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
values.description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [LOCATION]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Intercepted Supply Run
values.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]
