POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: limited supply
values.description:
Seems there’s a new upstart in the sector who hasn’t been paying the right dues to the right people. To teach them a little lesson, my client wants you to go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site.

The low-level lugs they got on site will probably make a stink about it and try to stop you. Handle them however you want but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

values.title: Junior Rank - Direct Medium Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hello,

Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 8 SCU in size.

Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?

[SIGN_OFF]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Double Dealing
values.description:
Rough & Ready recently provided fueling services for a hauler named [TargetName], who agreed to deliver their next load of supplies to us as compensation. Well, we just found out that the lying skag sold their latest shipment to a rival gang instead.

We’re looking for someone to track down and eliminate [TargetName|Last] for the double cross.

An old friend of mine just spotted the skag at [Location|Address]. Looks like they're loaded with more cargo that’s not coming our way, and traveling with an escort. We’re only paying you to take out the ship, so anything you find aboard is yours to keep.

- Smokey

values.title: Red Lvl. Contract: Protect Fuel Tanks and Escort Employees
values.description:
An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to [LOCATION] as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s [OBJECTS] and of their ships that may need assistance.

This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site.

If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering 6 MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on.

Stay safe, and good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Capture Arlington Gang Member Les Arlington
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = [Contractor|ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

An anonymous comm has tipped us off that Les Arlington, child of gang leader Maltrox Arlington, had been spotted picking up a delivery at a Covalex transfer center. We will provide you with the coordinates of where we believe their current whereabouts are.

Les is an experienced pilot who has been flying for almost as long as they’ve been walking and usually serves as the gang’s get-away pilot. It may be worthwhile to bring extra support ships in order to cut off any attempts at escape.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: [TargetName] Vanished
values.description:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to [TargetName]. Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to Abandoned Section and find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

values.title: Alliance Aid: Vital Package Retrieval
values.description:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid has not completed it's contract. The last known location has it still over at [LOCATION]. A courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to [DESTINATION].

THREAT LEVEL – It is unclear what happened to the ship, but we expect a malfunction. Still, caution is advised. Low level engagements expected.

TRAVEL – All transportation needs should be arranged by courier.

FTL Courier Services is proud to be assisting in Alliance Aid efforts to help fight the Levski outbreak.

values.title: Wasting Their Stockpile
values.description:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.

Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at [LOCATION]. I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out

values.title: Stand Our Ground
values.description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?

If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of 18 Council Scrip.

Stows out.

values.title: Stop Attack on High-Profile Client
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high-profile client decided to tour Nyx system but got jumped by hostile ships around [LOCATION].

Sounds like they’re overwhelmed. Any chance you could head to their location and provide support?

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: URGENT REFUEL REQUEST: [Ship]
values.description:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at Asteroid Mining Base. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use [FuelType]. If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen and [QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there.

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Inmate Maintenance Opportunity
values.description:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

values.title: Bleeding Edge Tech
values.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: get the goods
values.description:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that a derelict outpost received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to [DropOff1|address]. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two.

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes.

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

values.title: Small Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Stanton2 Unlawful Salvage Cover Up - Easy
Inter-Outpost Delivery at [DESTINATION] - Multiple Boxes
values.description:
Hi,

Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION].

Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a handheld tractor beam with you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Junior Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hi,

Hurston is requesting that we prioritize pick ups from the local mining facilities to free up space for what they’re extracting. Here’s everywhere you need to go:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]

Once collected, everything needs to get to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. They've said that all the containers will be at most 4 SCU in size. Sound like something you could handle?

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Another Chance to Impress
values.description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more.

Kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address] and I will consider the slate wiped clean.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

values.description:

Seems like [LOCATION] currently has some 1 SCU or smaller cargo that needs to be separated and delivered to a few different spots.

values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Senior Hauler Needed for Large Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a bunch of comms this morning. Seems one of the local trash collectors' ship is busted and we're gonna be picking up the slack.

I got a bunch of trash (32 SCU or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Rookie Rank - Direct Medium Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hey,

There's a bunch of scrap and waste waiting at a freight elevator at Riker Memorial Spaceport that needs to go to a freight elevator at [Destination|Address] for sorting. I know ArcCorp started an initiative to reduce waste and recycle more scrap on planet, but I haven’t seen any decrease in these types of hauls from them yet.

Are you available to move this batch of assorted junk (8 SCU containers or smaller) off-world for them?

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

[Contractor|SignOff]

values.title: Orison Relief: Medium Materials Order
values.description:
Ey up,

We're still on the hunt for more materials to help Crusader after the Nine Tails attack. Need a bit more this time though. Will make sure you're compensated accordingly.

After you've got the materials, head to [DESTINATION] and we'll get it sorted.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

values.title: Silent Strike
values.description:
Any interest in taking out a [TARGET] for us?

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by [LOCATION] soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss 3 Council Scrip to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]

values.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #6
values.description:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.

Find your way to [LOCATION] whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 14 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

values.title: [Title]
values.description: [Description]

values.title: Ripe for Retribution
values.description:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader [TargetName] is holed up at [location|address] working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without [TargetName|Last] getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out [TargetName|Last], but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.

Stows out.

values.title: Crash some ships
values.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION] and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

values.title: Retrieve Supplies
values.description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a [Ship] carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at [Location|Address]. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at Canard View. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery?

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: Wrecked Ships for Sale
values.description:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to [LOCATION]. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

values.title: Scrap Salvage at Rustville
values.description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at Rustville. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds.

- Stows

values.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
values.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

values.title: Combat Assistance - LOW THREAT
values.description:
[LOW THREAT]

~serviceBeacon(InitiatorName) is requesting combat assistance in deep space. If accepted, you will be paid ~serviceBeacon(PaymentAmount) aUEC upon elimination of the threat.

Distance to ~serviceBeacon(InitiatorName) : ~serviceBeacon(DistToInitiator)

values.title: Recover Cargo
values.description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo?

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

Fly Safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: All Things Come To An End
values.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [Location|Address], but [TargetName] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

values.title: Orange Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks
values.description:
I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS]. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.

For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: Overdrive Initiative: PRIORITY TARGETS
values.description:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

values.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
values.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.description:

There’s a load of stims at [LOCATION] ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers 4 SCU or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me?

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION2]

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

values.title: Illegal Blockade – Medical Supplies Needed
values.description:
The illegal quantum blockade of [Location] has interrupted normal trade routes and essentials are in short supply.

Crusader Security is looking for traders and haulers to provide much needed medical supplies to the station.

Prices offered by the station administration will be adjusted to reflect the situation with the Nine Tails, and in addition, Crusader will provide a hazard bonus upon successful transfer of the medical supplies because of the increased risk.

Thank you in advance for your support during these difficult times.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

values.title: Confiscate Contraband
values.description:
Crusader Security has learned that an illegal production facility at [Location|Address] is currently being used to manufacture contraband.

We are seeking a contractor to secure the site, confiscate any contraband, and deliver it to us at Seraphim Station. The administrative commodity terminal will allow you to submit the contraband into our evidence hold and collect your payment.

Now, this is an automated facility so it’s not clear how long they’ll be manufacturing for, or even how many people may be on site. To be safe, I would go in expecting to meet heavy resistance.

Your total compensation will be based on how packages are safely delivered into evidence.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Vanzant
ID# 712L921P

values.title: RSI Disc. Month: Urgent Refuel Request ([SHIP])
values.description:
Hey again,

Found a beacon from one of those new [SHIP] ships out in [LOCATION] that needs refueling. Just got off comms with them and they said they ran into some trouble with some local outlaws and had to make a sharp exit so weren't able to fill up on [FUELTYPE] before heading out.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hoping we can get out to those nice folks before anything bad happens to them, been hearing a lot of nasty rumors about those parts recently. Watch your back and make sure you get home safely.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
""We’ve got your back""

values.title: Track Down Traitor
values.description:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on [TargetName]. A known member of the Headhunters gang, [TargetName|Last] has betrayed Humankind by being a known alien ally who associates with them in both a personal and business capacity. XenoThreat wants these traitorous associations stopped immediately before they bring more alien influence to Pyro. We’ll pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates [TargetName|Last] for these crimes against Humanity.

LOCATION UPDATE: [TargetName|Last] was recently spotted with an escort at [Location|Address].

Comm. Spec. Engler

values.title: Orison Relief: Neutralize Nine Tails Reprisal
values.description:
Some of the Nine Tails responsible for the attack on Orison have reportedly been sighted around [LOCATION] marshalling their forces. Crusader is concerned they’re planning another attack, so this is a job that needs doing well.

You’ll be tasked with infiltrating the site and neutralizing the Nine Tails however necessary before they can enact a retaliation attempt on Orison. As I’m sure you’re aware, these guys are bad news, so be careful they don’t get the better of you.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: New Defense Contract: [TARGET] Elimination
values.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been hired to combat the rising number of outlaws using Nyx as a staging ground for their operations, with the intention of attacking neighboring UEE systems.

As a preventative measure, we require you to travel to [LOCATION] and eliminate the ringleader [TARGET] to deter their planned attack on Stanton. They and their crew are highly dangerous and you are advised to bring a wingman for support.

Contractors who can prove themselves reliable and competent in executing operations will be eligible for future missions with InterSec.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

values.title: XenoThreat = GoodLoot
values.description:

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting.

values.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
values.description:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing.

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to [LOCATION] to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 1 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Eugene Walton

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely.

Think you can rise to the occasion?

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

values.description:
Hi there,

The refinery at [LOCATION] has been busy. They’ve processed a bunch of Aluminum into containers 16 SCU or smaller, and are looking to get it shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see which ones needed this stuff and was able to put together this run.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION2]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION3]

Should be an easy run for you, if you’re free.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: No Fly Zone
values.description:
Some competition has taken root at [LOCATION] and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out

values.title: Strategic Resource Reserve – Small Resupply
values.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation.

To that end, we were hoping that you could deliver the needed supplies to Pyro Gateway. We have arranged shipment to Pyro from there.

I leave it up to you to decide how best to procure and refine the resources, but Daymar or Aberdeen might be good places to start mining.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Defenders needed against Headhunters
values.description:
We received an emergency comm from [LOCATION] reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.

If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Red Level Contract: Secure Threatened Space
values.description:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the location marker on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least three friends to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 24 MG Scrip at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Eradicate UEE Threat: [TARGET]
values.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: [LOCATION]
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Capital Ship
Briefing: An outlaw fleet lead by [TARGET] has been planning a potentially devastating strike against sensitive UEE targets. InterSec has been tasked with dealing with this threat before their attack can be launched.

After putting together a fighting force of your own, head to the site and engage with the hostiles there. Their leader will not risk entering into the fray themselve unless they feel their operation is suitably at risk. Stay at the site and take out hostile targets, until you can engage with the groups leader directly and put a stop to this heinous attack once and for all.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

values.title: JR. LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.
You will be required to lift up to .25 SCU in weight.
Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Assist Retreating Ship
values.description:
One of our people is currently under attack at [LOCATION]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away.

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Junior Rank - Direct Medium Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hello,

There’s some junk waiting at a freight elevator in [Location|Address] that needs to go to a freight elevator at [Destination|Address] for processing. I've confirmed that the containers won't be bigger than 8 SCU.

My mom would’ve loved this run. She’s one of those who thinks every scrapyard is filled with hidden treasures. Can’t even tell you how many hours I spent bored out of my mind following her around one. If that’s your thing, here’s a chance to actually make credits going to one.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Track Down [TargetName]
values.description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since.

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened.

Stows out.

values.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
values.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

values.title: Salvager Needed (Small Special Order of RMC / Components)
values.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job tractor beam.

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, even with the amount of ships buzzing through a system as populated as Stanton, so don't be surprised if you have to put a bit more effort into hunting down what's needed.

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [Destination|Address].

For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

values.title: Alliance Aid: Large Supply of Research Resource
values.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari needs your assistance. As part of the Alliance Aid effort, our scientists have shifted their entire focus to assisting Levski deal with Molina mold. Unfortunately, the team’s progress has stalled due to a lack of a key resource.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to [DESTINATION].

If you need help locating this resource, I suggest checking the 'Forager's Guide' in your mobiGlas Journal for more information.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

values.title: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #7
values.description:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to [LOCATION] to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 16 MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

values.title: Experienced Rank - Direct Large Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hello,

Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 32 SCU in size.

Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?

[SIGN_OFF]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Surprise Party
values.description:
Some numskull flying a [TARGET] was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.

There’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of 1 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

Stows out.

values.title: Junior Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_MultiToSingle]

values.title: Knock Power Out
values.description:
Got a few scavs that have rooted themselves into [LOCATION]. We have our own plans there and need the place cleared out.

That's why I want you to ho and turn off their power. Let's see if that doesn't cause these rats to abandon the place for good.

-Stows

values.title: [Contractor|DataHeistTitle_E]
values.description: [Contractor|DataHeistDescription_E]

values.title: Headhunter Pilot in Trouble
values.description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [LOCATION] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows

values.title: Respond to Distress Beacon
values.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy on a resupply run dropped a distress beacon near [LOCATION]. They’re not answering any comms, so I assume the situation is serious. That convoy has some skilled pilots, so if they’re not responding then they definitely need the help.

We’ll compensate you to support that convoy.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Bleeding Edge Tech
values.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
values.description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with Orison and take you to visit Kel-To, a weapons store here in Orison.

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

values.title: Trainee Hauler Needed for Direct Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Risky [Ship] Salvage Job
values.description:
We’ve got our eye on a [ship] near [location] that’s ripe for salvaging. We’re too busy to snag it ourselves, so why not spread the wealth, right?

If you send us some credits, we’ll send you the ship’s exact coordinates. Don’t take too long to think it over, though. You’ve probably got about [timer] minutes until security gets there to check out the wreck. Could be more, could be less.

You could either tow it somewhere else first, or you could try to scrap what you can onsite before security shows. Don’t care which as long as you get it taken care of. And once you've salvaged everything you want, just go ahead and abandon this contract to clear your map. Helps keep everything nice and tidy.

values.title: Experienced Rank - Direct Large Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hey,

Any interest in doing the Stanton leg of an interstellar run?

There’s a haul of Waste waiting in containers 32 SCU or smaller to be picked up from a freight elevator at [Location|Address] and delivered to a freight elevator at [Destination|Address]. No need to take it any further than that. I’ve got someone else lined up to run it through the jump to its final destination.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping

values.title: Small Purchase Order: Vehicle Mined Ore
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Alliance Aid: Courier Needed
values.description:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid went down at [LOCATION]. Courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to [DESTINATION].

THREAT LEVEL – There is a strong chance that the courier was attacked by outlaws eager to acquire the vital supplies needed to stop the Molina mold out break in Levski. Medium level engagements expected.

TRAVEL – All transportation needs should be arranged by courier.

FTL Courier Services thanks you for helping us do our part for Alliance Aid.

values.title: Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
values.description:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a handheld tractor beam.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Defend Fuel Tanks
values.description:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their [OBJECTS], based in [LOCATION]. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.

If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_MultiToSingle]

values.title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Direct Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Fuel to the Fire
values.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that [location|address] is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high.

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

values.title: Getting what we deserve
values.description:
Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at [LOCATION] and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a heavy-duty tractor beam and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.

values.title: Grab ‘n’ go
values.description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to [LOCATION]. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a heavy-duty tractor beam on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_MultiToSingle]

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: Firebird Mod
values.description: Been digging into Aegis Sabre ship. Firebird is very bomb-y. Good build but could make some fun change to it. If you want, I can do. Have a look and tell me. Bye.

values.title: Red Wind Easy Cargo Recovery
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]

Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

values.title: Treat yourself to a fight
values.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TARGET] has been spotted flying around [LOCATION].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

values.title: Alliance Aid: Escort Needed
values.description:
Citizens for Prosperity need a combat-experienced pilot to provide extra support to an Alliance Aid pilot who is making a vital trip from [LOCATION] for the ongoing relief effort.

Outlaws have been launching more attacks thanks to the increased activity brought on by the Molina Mold outbreak, so it’ll be your job to make sure that they stay safe while they’re completing their work. This route is relatively safe, so I'm not expecting too much trouble, but its better not to take the risk.

If you’re interested, you’ll rendezvous there and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: [Contractor|BountyTitleVeryEasy]
values.description: [Contractor|BountyDescriptionVeryEasy]

values.title: Member Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hi,

There’s a load of stims at [Location|Address] ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers 4 SCU or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me?

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [Destination|Address]
- Freight elevator at [Destination1|Address]
- Freight elevator at [Destination2|Address]

Glad I never picked up the habit myself because I swear I get more delivery update requests for “where are my stims?!?” than any other kind of shipment.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

[Contractor|SignOff]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Repossess Supplies
values.description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system.

That shipment was delivered to [Pickup1|Address]. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the [item], and take it to [Dropoff1|Address] so we can properly dispose of it.

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_MultiToSingle]

values.title: Out of Salvage – Large Resupply
values.description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash is practically out of stock.

That’s why you’re going to put together a full fleet to do a resupply run to [Destination|Address] and bring them the salvaged materials.

Scrap it yourself or take it off some unsuspecting scav. Should be able to find some wrecks orbiting around most planets. Your call. Either way, as soon as we get the supplies, we’ll put it to good use building back up everything we lost.

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

values.title: Junior Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hello!

There’s a load of cargo (4 SCU or smaller) that needs to be delivered to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. The only thing is that the cargo is spread across a few locations, which I’ve listed out below.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]

Makes no difference what order you grab the stuff, as long as it’s all delivered.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

[SIGN_OFF]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

values.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.

The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Braden Corchado

values.title: Getting What They Deserve
values.description:
I got a situation I need dealing with pronto. A rival crew has intercepted a major shipment of gear I was expecting and all hell is breaking loose. The pilot’s ghosted, the ship’s busted, and it’s only a matter of time before they take my shit and leave. If you’re up for cracking these assholes, head to [LOCATION] and get my five packages.

Head’s up though, the pilot they ghosted was one of my best, so this crew’s got to be seriously kitted out. Bring your finest mates with you and show the bastards no mercy. Understood?

When you’re done, take the gear to [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a serious cut of the takings.

values.title: A Chance to Impress
values.description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives.

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim.

If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills.

Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET] over at [LOCATION].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

values.title: Data Transfer
values.description:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.

If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION] that we want.

All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Strategic Detatrine Reserve – Medium Resupply
values.description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation.

To that end, we were hoping that you and a team of your choosing would be able to resupply [Destination|Address] with detatrine.

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several depots around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Ella Tieno

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club

Need a skilled operator with combat experience to investigate the last known location of [TARGET]. Their employer hired us to look for they as they were carrying some highly valuable cargo, but the trackers have been disabled and the pilot is no longer responding.

values.description:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.

Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a [TARGET] and will be passing by [LOCATION] soon. Eugene Walton

values.title: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
values.description:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at [LOCATION]. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a a heavy-duty tractor beam and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

When you’re done, take the stuff to [DESTINATION] and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

-Twitch

values.title: Target at [LOCATION]
values.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [LOCATION] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TARGET] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TARGET] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid.

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

values.title: Destroy Illegal Drugs
values.description:
We’ve discovered that a group is trying to start up their own drug business over at [Location|Address]. While they seem to be your average low-level thugs, the product they’re producing is toxic and responsible for the deaths of multiple civilians, so we can’t afford to allow any more to be sold.

We’re are working on a larger operation that will shut them down for good, but in the meanwhile we need to stop the flow of their drugs. That’s why Crusader wants you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there.

They will undoubtedly have guards protecting the stash, but I don’t expect them to be too much of a threat.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K
