POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-892 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
values.description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.

A Club member has run out of [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST]. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their [SHIP] and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates.

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-529 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.

Interested?

values.title: Additional Resources For Research
values.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.

In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

values.title: twice the headache
values.description:
Have another pair that needs simultaneous deathing. Seems to be getting more and more popular as a murder option.

This time it's [TargetName] and [TargetName2]. Both are supposed to be pretty skilled operators and they won't be flying alone.

I'd make sure whoever you get to help you on this one can handle a fight.

values.title: Keep [LOCATION] Safe
values.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that [LOCATION] is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their [OBJECTS]. It won't stand.

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including any friendly ships in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

Northrock has been hard at work to identify some of the key players in the recent attacks on RSI's Discovery Month event. As a result, we have located a high ranking member of a local outlaw gang named [TARGET].

We've triangulated their last known location was [LOCATION], where we believe they are preparing their next attack. Intel suggest they're a cautious individual that may require drawing out by eliminating their comrades first. Bringing a team of skilled operators is heavily advised.

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group

values.title: Reclaim Stolen Cargo
values.description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at Canard View.

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to Canard View. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.description: Wikelo really like this little Human ship. Pulse feel very fast. Can have many configuration to make Pulse go faster. If you want, can give you configurated Pulse that I like. Have list of what I want for job. Bye.

values.title: Rally to Help Clips Convoy
values.description:
One of our Clips is in a tight spot. Just got a comm from ‘em saying their convoy is being swarmed by the People’s Alliance and they need help on the double. Well, they said it in a more colorful way than that. All I’ll say is that I don’t want to hear what they’ll say to me if they don’t survive and are forced to regen.

Situation must be serious if this Clip is freaking out. Really need you to get to [LOCATION] immediately, and ensure that they make it out alive.

Stows out.

values.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract
values.description:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract.

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system.

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TARGET]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid.

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

values.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: [TargetName] (VHRT)
values.description:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

BlacJac just got word that a very high-risk target, [TargetName], was spotted moving through the flight lanes over at [Location|Address] piloting a formidable ship with a heavy escort.

We want this bounty closed out before they commit any more crimes. Gather whatever resources or support you need, and head out as soon as you can.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

values.title: Shut Off Power at [LOCATION]
values.description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [LOCATION] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

values.title: Failed Negotiations
values.description:
Ran into a bit of crap luck that I'm hoping you can help me right.

A few days ago, I hired the crew of the 'Pride of Arliss' to obtain some important data for me. They pulled off the job no problem, but the bastard of a captain comm'd me demanding more credits. Turns out it wasn't the first time he's tried to pull this trick either because in middle of "negotiating" with me, his ship was attacked by some very pissed off individuals looking to teach him a lesson.

Our comm got cut off when the shooting started and that was the last I heard from him. I'm guessing he's as good as ghosted, but I want you to head to the Pride of Arliss and try to get my data off the captain's personal datapad.

Once you have it, I set up a secure transmission channel at the ARC-L1 rest stop. Travel there and when you're in range, submit the data to me through this contract to get paid.

Don’t try to screw me over either. Karma can be a real asshole.

values.title: Easy Pickings
values.description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves?

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

values.title: Down For the Count
values.description:
[TARGET] was a name that proved particularly troublesome for some time. Whether a master of evasion or just unerringly lucky all of our attempts have thus far failed.

With that being said, it seems that someone else may have beaten us to the punch so to speak. We’d like you to visit [LOCATION] and confirm if the target has indeed been neutralized. But be advised, I suspect they’re former crew may still be in the area, most likely out of a misplaced sense of loyalty. I’d suggest a crew of your own for this one, but will defer to your expertise.

Sincerely,

Vaughn

values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In need of a contractor who can report in now. A client has found themselves in hot water over at [LOCATION] and a protection detail to get away from an asteroid base. They’ve reported multiple, well-armed hostile ships meaning you’ll need a crew of your own to deal with them. Based on the client’s account, these attackers seem highly motivated so they will likely not back down easily.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Treat yourself to a fight
values.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TARGET] has been spotted flying around [LOCATION].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

values.title: Rookie Rank - Direct Extra Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]

values.title: [TARGET] needs stomping
values.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TARGET] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it.

Last we heard they were spotted around [LOCATION]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

values.title: Headhunter Ship Needs Backup
values.description:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at [LOCATION].

The real kicker is the fool has a full hold. Can't really afford to lose the stuff they're carrying, so I'd appreciate it if you could go bail them out for me.

- Stows out

values.title: Search for Ship
values.description:
Just lost contact with a [Ship] on an important run. Before they went dark, the crew was convinced someone was following them, so I’d put money on them being under attack.

Looking for someone to get their ass over to [Location|Address] to search for the ship and retrieve the goods. If I’m right, there will be some uninvited guests hanging around that will need to be dealt with too. Once you’ve secured the stuff, it needs to go to Rustville.

You down to crack a few skulls and lug some cargo. Sounds simple enough, right?

Stows out.

values.title: Need a hitter
values.description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows

values.title: Time to roll on CFP
values.description:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at [LOCATION] and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.

values.description:
Hey,

Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?

Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship with enough space to store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send you the creds.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

-Stows out

values.title: Fight for a Free Pyro
values.description:
XenoThreat’s efforts to keep outside influences from infecting this system is being tested by a group that dares to call itself Citizens for Prosperity. A prominent group member, [TargetName], has established operations at [Location|Address] and is already hard at work spreading their lies and propaganda to anyone that will listen. If we want Pyro to remain independent of UEE and alien influence, then something must be done about this now.

That’s why XenoThreat is issuing a kill order for [TargetName|Last]. And knowing how important they are to Citizens for Prosperity’s operations, I wouldn’t be surprised if you had to fight your way through a bunch of their most fanatical followers first before you even get a shot at them. But remember [TargetName|Last] is your target, and payment hinges solely on you making sure they’re eliminated.

Comm. Spec. Engler

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-521 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around [Location|address], disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force.

Though the overall situation is dire, the theft of the Zeta-Prolanide is our priority. Without direct action, the loss of the sector's Zeta-Prolanide stores could have a devastating effects to the wider economy of the whole system.

While local security forces are investigating the incursion, they've tracked the stolen inventory to several locations. CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

values.title: Steal Subsidies
values.description:
Leave it to the lying UEE to say they’re not involved with the operations of Citizens for Prosperity simply because they “donate” supplies to a tertiary aid organization who then immediately delivers it right to them.

We just got word that one of these government aid shipments was dropped off at a Citizens for Prosperity aligned outpost. That’s why we’ll pay you to raid [Pickup1|Address] and claim the [item] for the cause. Once you deliver everything to [Dropoff1|Address] we can redistribute the shipment to help in our fight. Nothing better than using the enemies resources against them.

But don’t think they’ll just hand the stuff over to you. Even though Citizens for Prosperity are supposedly here to bring peace, you best be prepared to go toe to toe with ‘em.

Comm. Spec. Engler

values.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ambush An Amateur
values.description:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy?

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a [TARGET]. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that [LOCATION] is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: A Troublesome Task
values.description:
I fear this is another one of those assignments that will take your full skillset to see to completion.

[TARGET] is aboard a very heavily armed vessel protected by at least two equally armed escorts. They are traveling near [LOCATION].

Not for the faint of heart.

Fondly,
Vaughn

values.title: XenoThreat = GoodLoot
values.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat.

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting.

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c

values.title: Rookie Rank - Extra Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Greetings,

Seems like [LOCATION] currently has some 1 SCU or smaller cargo that needs to be separated and delivered to a few different spots.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]

Drop-offs can be done in whatever order works best for you.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

[SIGN_OFF]

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: URGENT: Retake Security Post Kareah
values.description:
Security Post Kareah is under attack by an unknown number of assailants.

Crusader is seeking contractors to quickly travel to the station and eliminate all trespassers in the vicinity before our security forces are overwhelmed.

We’re not sure whether the attackers are targeting the contraband in our evidence lockup or our CrimeStat database, but whatever they’re after, they need to be dealt with. You will receive a combat bonus for each target neutralized.

By accepting this contract, you agree to abide by all Crusader Security protocols: If you harm any guards or other authorized contractors while on the station, your contract will be terminated and you will be marked as a target.

Time is of the essence, but make sure you’re well equipped to handle the hostiles before responding.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

values.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
values.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Senior Rank - Medium Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hey,

The refinery at [LOCATION] has been busy. They’ve processed a mix of refined ores and are looking to get the containers (16 SCU or smaller) shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see where this stuff is needed and was able to put together this run.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION2]

Should be an easy run for you, if you’re free.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

values.title: Make jumpy ATLS shoot
values.description:
Find very fun piece to add to big human suit that let you jump very high. Now you shoot and jump. Exciting.

If you want, bring me these to [DESTINATIONS]. Will make.

Wikelo

values.title: Junior Hauler Needed for Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Got a bunch of comms this morning. Seems one of the local trash collectors' ship is busted and we're gonna be picking up the slack.

I got a bunch of trash (4 SCU or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.description:
I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS]. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.

For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

values.title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
values.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TARGET] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION], so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

values.title: Fortune ship for you
values.description: Hello, practicing on making ship fly better. Xi'an help human make ship. Fly good. Salvage good. But Wikelo can make better if you want. Bring things and will do. Bye.

values.title: Red Lvl. Contract: Protect Fuel Tanks
values.description:
An emergency contract just came through about a gang of violent thugs wreaking havoc on one of our VIP clients’ infrastructures. If available, we need you to rush to [LOCATION] and defend the client’s extremely valuable [OBJECTS] at all costs.

Foxwell is extremely aware of this group, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site.

If you manage to survive the encounter with the client’s property intact, we’re adding 9 MG Scrip any main contractor brave enough to take this job on.

Stay safe, and good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Escapee Bounty Assignment: [TARGET]
values.description:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.

The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

values.title: Experienced Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hello!

There’s a load of cargo (4 SCU or smaller) that needs to be delivered to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. The only thing is that the cargo is spread across a few locations, which I’ve listed out below.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION2]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION3]

values.title: Headhunter Pilot in Trouble
values.description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [LOCATION] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows

values.title: Exciting New Opportunities with Foxwell Enforcement
values.description:
Are you an experienced contractor looking to increase your income with some security work? Or maybe you’re new to the field and are looking for some hands-on experience?

Foxwell Enforcement are looking for enthusiastic new contractors to help with local law enforcement. To see if you’re the right fit for us, we’d like for you to head over to [LOCATION] and support the security forces on site. Local gang members have been giving that spot problems. Help the local forces take care of these outlaws to qualify for more contract opportunities with Foxwell.

Contractors are employed on a strictly freelance basis. Foxwell expects contractors to supply their own weapons and armor and does not accept any responsibility for any injuries, damages, or deaths accumulated during the contract.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Green light on [LOCATION]
values.description:
It's sad to say but we lost one of our outposts to XenoThreat. Appalling if you ask me, but that's why we're looking for someone who's got the time and ammunition to take it back.

If that's you, head over to [LOCATION] and take it back.

Stows out.

values.title: Junior Hauler Needed for Direct Medium Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 8 SCU in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Convince Upstarts to Abandon Sector
values.description:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named [TARGET] who is operating out of [LOCATION]. They've become a real concern for the Headhunters.

It's time to shut them down.

Head over, take out [TARGET] and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave.

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

values.title: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Protect Fuel Tanks and Escort Employees
values.description:
We need a contractor to provide convoy and protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our elite clients' are under attack from a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS] and ships. You'll need to keep the crew safe as they traverse the area, as well as make sure the assets stay as intact. These thugs look like they can do some real damage, so be sure you engage them with caution or the client might not be the only one to take heavy losses.

If you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 3 MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

values.title: Head Hunting
values.description:
The Headhunters have assembled a special strike team whose sole purpose is to attack, disrupt, and undermine our operations. As much as I’m loath to admit it, they’ve had a few small successes and are quickly becoming a concern.

XenoThreat knows the best way to kill a snake is by cutting off its head, so we’re issuing a kill order for the strike team’s commander [TargetName], who according to our intelligence sources, has been hiding at [Location|Address] for a few days now.

I’d expect strong resistance from the Headhunter forces there. From what we’ve heard, [TargetName|Last] got this command partially because of the fierce loyalty they inspire in others. Putting your own crew together to tackle this would be a solid operational strategy.

Happy Head Hunting,

Comm. Spec. Engler

values.title: Eliminate Vanduul Ship
values.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: InterSec requires the services of a skilled pilot who’s prepared to assist in taking down a dangerous Vanduul target that has been involved in numerous attacks.

Vanduul incursions have been on the rise recently, posing not only a threat to the system of Nyx, but the UEE as a whole. It is imperative that these sightings are responded to in a swift and efficient manner.

We require you to fly to the last known sighting of the Vanduul ship at [LOCATION] and eliminate them immediately.

Vanduul pilots are highly skilled and extremely dangerous. Engage the enemy immediately and do not hesitate – they will not show the same mercy.

Compensation proportionate to the risk of the contract will be awarded.

Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

values.title: Help Headhunters at [LOCATION]
values.description:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to [LOCATION] are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops.

There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.

The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus 7 Council Scrip.

- Stows

values.title: Alliance Aid: Thwart Cargo-jacking
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Cargo Retrieval
APPROVAL CODE = JJ-13

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Alliance Aid just comm'd in a panic. A vital shipment that they were counting on hasn't shown up. All signs point to it getting jacked by thieves along the way so they're counting on us to make sure it gets delivered.

You're going to head to the [LOCATION], assess the situation, neutralize any remaining hostiles in the area, and secure the shipment for drop off at [DESTINATION]. Be sure to have a few support ships with you just in case things get extra rough.

Be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to handle the cargo.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Worth the trouble
values.description:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at [LOCATION]. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.

If you can get your best pilots together and a heavy-duty tractor beam you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.

I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll send you the creds.

Stows out.

values.title: Defend [LOCATION] from Outlaws
values.description:
We learned that [LOCATION] is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws.

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: JR. LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.
You will be required to lift up to .25 SCU in weight.
Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Secure [LOCATION] from Upstarts
values.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any friendly ships need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.

If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 3 Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

values.title: My Dad's Stuff
values.description:
Hi,

I'm looking for someone to head to the Covalex Gundo station near Crusader and grab some items. I know this may sound like stealing, but it's my dad's stuff. You see, he was on Gundo station when it had its accident. My mom says that we need to wait until Covalex says so, but I don't think that's fair because I miss him so much. I would like something to remember him by and I don't want to wait any longer because I might start forgetting things. I'll pay you to get box 510 for me and take to [Destination] so I can have it.

Thank you very much,
Baylor Ward

values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: A Simple Task
values.description:
I have a new assignment for you.

Dispatch [TARGET]. You should be able to find them at [LOCATION].

I do not expect them to put up much of a struggle. At least not a formidable one.

values.title: Locate Missing Family Member
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP45648
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
A client has tasked us with tracking down with one of their family members who has gone missing. After exhibiting erratic behavior, they cut off all communications and left for [SYSTEM]. We were able to track down their general whereabouts but need an investigator to head there in person to assess the situation.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate [MISSINGPERSONLIST] at [LOCATION] and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
There is a high chance that you will encounter hostiles while conducting your search. We recommend considering bringing along backup to support you.

values.title: Trade Council Scrip for Favors?
values.description:
If you want other way to get favors from Wikelo, have thing for you. Wikelo have need for scrip given out by Council group. Wikelo not part of thief souli, but has business from time to time.

If you bring scrips to [DESTINATIONS], will trade for favor.

Bye.

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-542 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at [Dropoff1|Address].

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado

values.title: need an out?

Hi there. We haven’t had a chance to work together yet but I’m in a bit of a bind here and I could use another body. Not for nothing, of course. I’m all for a good quid pro quo.

One of my associates who was serving some time in Klescher was supposed to bring me a datachip, but then they went quiet. Now I’m assuming they’re dead, but here’s the deal: if you finish his job, I wipe your crimestat. Not bad, right?

Your predecessor was apparently planning on using some old tunnels to make his escape. He made it sound like they weren't exactly the easiest thing to access, but I trust you can figure it out. I'm guessing you'll find his body somewhere in there and if we’re lucky, he'll still have the chip on him.

Once you get it, finish getting out however you can. Then get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. You might want to watch out for Hurston Security, though. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat.

Then you can go and enjoy your newfound freedom. If you do this right, maybe I’ll have more lucrative work for you down the line.

They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat.

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-970 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: let's help each other
values.description:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents.

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address].

This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [LOCATION] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

values.title: Junior Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hi there,

There’s a few sites on ArcCorp that need their waste and scrap collected (all boxes 4 SCU or smaller) and taken to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Doesn’t matter what order you do the run, as long as you grab it all.

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION2]

You know, my mom was a hauler who specialized in runs like this. It might not be the most glamorous stuff, but she claimed these runs had the best pay-to-risk ratio. Pirates never gave her any trouble when they found out what was on board.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: Up in Smoke
values.description:
We’ve been trying to access some sensitive data over at [Location|Address] but there seems to only be one backdoor we can use. The issue is we need someone onsite to trigger it. And I really do mean trigger it.

If you can head over there and destroy part of their infrastructure, the emergency back up systems will kick online and we should be able to access everything we want.

Wish I could see the surprise look on the faces of the lowlifes running the place when it happens.

-Bit Zeros

values.title: Rookie Hauler Needed for Small Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of the folks over at [LOCATION] just hit me up about a pile of cargo, 4 SCU or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: XL Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
values.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
values.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

values.title: Ling Family Rookie Cargo Haul - Small Scale
values.description:
Hey,

Any chance you’d be willing to do a haul into Pyro? I know it can get dangerous there but this is for a good cause. A group of new CFP members have moved to [DESTINATION] and had a tough time adjusting to life in the system. They all left stuff behind in Stanton, because their transporter didn’t have room, so we’ve been hired to pick it all up and bring it to them.

Here are the pick ups:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]
- [LOCATION 4]

CFP leaders hope that bringing them this stuff will make the system feel more like home. Let’s make sure this one goes down smoothly. Remember to equip your handheld tractor beam, and a ship that can fit 2 SCU cargo containers.

Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

values.title: Red Wind Seeking New Pilots
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We're looking to hire an independent pilot that's interested in running a local route for us.

PACKAGES FOR PICK UP (ANY ORDER)
· Package #[Item1|SerialNumber] from the [Pickup1|Address]

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
· Package #[Item1|SerialNumber] to the [Dropoff1|Address]

If you pull this off, we can see about other contracts in the future. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

[Contractor|SignOff]

values.title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

values.title: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
values.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.

The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Orison Relief: Large Supply Haul
values.description:
Hey, it’s El.

Off the bat – this particular job’s a big deal, so if you’re looking to take this one on for us, make sure you’re confident in your ability to do a job well.

We’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver medical supplies to [DESTINATION]. Pick up’s at [LOCATION]. Bear in mind, this is gonna be a big one, so make sure bring a handheld tractor beam and a ship that can hold 16 SCU cargo containers otherwise it might be a little rough.

I can’t stress the importance of this contract enough – lots of good people got hurt in those attacks, and it’s our responsibility to do what we can to help them in the aftermath. We owe the victims that much, at the very least.

Let’s do right by them,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Experienced Hauler Needed for Direct Large Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.

On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: See What’s Out There
values.description:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?

If so, get on over to the location marker on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on.

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of 2 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

- Stows

values.title: Senior Hauler Needed for Large Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

values.title: Deep space hit
values.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TARGET] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TARGET] around [LOCATION]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

values.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

values.title: Minor Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
values.description:
Hi,

One of our outposts at [LOCATION] is in need of some light repairs. The folks onsite have estimated that you’ll need three fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to fix up to three or so pipes.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks again for your help,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Fuel to the Fire
values.description:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that [location|address] is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high.

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

values.title: Breach and Steal
values.description:
Hey there.

Nine Tails got themselves a little problem. As it turns out, they got a little side biz in the underground organ trade. Now that an area I generally like to steer well clear of, but a gig’s a gig, right? It seems that one of their mobile butcher shops aboard the 'October Rising' got pinched by private security while out chopping. Now the Nine Tails are willing to cut ties with the ship and its crew (who are probably all dead anyway), but they need a particular crate extracted. Guess it was a special order or something.

Anyway, get aboard the October Rising, get the package, and get out.

Security’s still hanging around so watch yourself and maybe bring some friends, but remember, your priority is the package. If you're looking to save yourself some extra hassle, you could also black out the area by shutting down the nearest comm array if you want to avoid the crimestats for, you know, killing a bunch of a security. But hey, you do you.

Once you’re out, drop the package off at the clinic on Grim HEX and I’ll sort your payment.

Easy peasy,

Ruto

values.title: Recover VIP Covalex Shipment
values.description:
Hey,

Only looking for contractors who are the best of the best for this one. One of our most valued clients is expecting an incredibly important shipment which is now seriously overdue.

Here at Covalex, we pride ourselves on treating all of our clients equally, offering outstanding levels of service regardless of what we're delivering. That being said, if we lose this contract someone's gonna be in hot water and I really can't afford for that person to be me.

The tracker is reporting that the last contractor's ship is over at [LOCATION]. Don't take any chances with this one, you'll need a ship that can hold [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to collect it all.

Deliver the shipment to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this whole mess behind us. And you'll make a sizeable heap of credits in the process. Not bad, right?

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Deal with [TARGET] and Support Forces
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. [TARGET] and their crew were identified executing a raid on [LOCATION]. If their MO holds true, [TARGET] has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again.

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of [TARGET] difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force [TARGET] to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Headhunter Needs Help
values.description:
You busy? A promising prospect was doing a special run for me but ran into trouble with the People’s Alliance around [LOCATION]. This one’s on me. Knew they weren’t the best dogfighter but thought they could do this without running into any other ships.

Told ‘em to hold tight and do everything they can to stay alive until support gets there. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for someone with your skillset.

-Stows

values.title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: [SHIP]
values.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] looking to be topped up with [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: Our Version of The Truth
values.description:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Stows out.

values.title: RSI Disc. Month: Constellation Rental Offer
values.description:
Calling all RSI Enthusiasts!

A core value of Robert Space Industries is exploration and adventure - and in keeping with that - we are thrilled to provide all pilots with the chance to test fly the new RSI Constellation Mk V!

All you have to do is collect the Golden Constellation box from the plinth at one of our special event locations and deliver it to another RSI Event Platform. Once you've done that, you'll be able to enjoy the test flight period. It’s as simple as that!

The Constellation Mk V is one of RSI's most versatile ships to date. Featuring four S5 weapons, two remote turrets, and 240 SCU of cargo storage, this ship caters for all kinds of adventures.

We hope you enjoy this opportunity to experience the future of spaceflight first hand and that it will be just the first of many more adventures to come.

Enjoy your journey,

Christoph Roester
RSI Community Outreach Manager
---
Roberts Space Industries
Delivering the Stars since 2075

It would be best for you to bring a few trusted friends to help handle this crew.

Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 7 Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.

Security there's being run by [TARGET] and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows

Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TARGET], who's been driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around [LOCATION], so head out there and do the deed.

values.title: Elite Op
values.description:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.

Already got a spot picked out. If you get to [LOCATION] there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the [TARGET] and its escorts to pass by.

With a bonus of 16 Council Scrip for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.

- Stows

values.title: Wipe Out XenoThreat Servers
values.description:
Something just fell into my lap that is way too good to pass up. XenoThreat's intelligence gathering is a bit of legend in the circles I run in and it turns out that they're storing a whole heap of their best intel at [LOCATION].

Would be a shame if someone, say like you, were to go there and blow it all up, huh?

-Stows out

values.title: Outsmarting our Enemies
values.description:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at [LOCATION]. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out

values.title: Extensive Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
values.description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at [LOCATION] suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
values.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.

The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION], then we can sort your payment.

A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

Stows out.

values.title: Additional Resources For Research
values.description:

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.

In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
