values.title: Dangerous Ambush
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a [TARGET], who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.

Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an emission cloud near [LOCATION] which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of 12 MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Seize the Data
values.description:
Been hunting down a particular parcel of data and right when I get a break the ship gets attacked by this converted Nine Tails Reclaimer called the Black Kite. I tried to hack into the servers on the Black Kite to see if they copied the data, but couldn't find a way to remotely get past their encryption protocols without the physical key.

That's where you come in. I need someone to breach their ship, get a hold of their decryption key, and decrypt the server so I can remotely pull down what I need.

You're smart enough to know who we're dealing with here, so plan accordingly. Since it's gonna ruffle some powerful feathers, let's not leave anything to chance. Destroy the Black Kite when you're done to cover both our asses.

values.title: Headhunter Ship Needs Backup
values.description:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at [LOCATION].

The real kicker is the fool has a full hold. Can't really afford to lose the stuff they're carrying, so I'd appreciate it if you could go bail them out for me.

- Stows out

values.title: Vital Resources Needed For Research
values.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: saldynium, jaclium, and carinite.

In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

values.title: Running the Gauntlet
values.description:
The CDF has partnered with Anvil Aerospace to find the most capable operatives in the system.

If you find one of these Platinum certifications, you can redeem the ticket at a ship kiosk at New Deal, Astro Armada or Crusader Showroom for a free F8C.

The catch is that your identity and location has been shared with participants throughout the system. For everyone else, if you can stop the ticketholder before they get to the kiosk, you can claim the ticket for your own.

Whoever makes it will not only receive this next generation superiority fighter, but also prove that they have what it takes for the toughest CDF assignments.

Good luck.

values.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
values.description:
Hi,

This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.

Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.

If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of [ITEM] that needs to go from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold 2 SCU cargo containers, and a handheld tractor beam to move them around.

Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.

Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to [dropoff1|address].

values.description:
Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at [LOCATION] and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a heavy-duty tractor beam and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.

values.description:
Some numskull flying a [TARGET] was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.

There’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of 1 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

Stows out.

values.title: Tactical Strike
values.description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.

We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

Reviewing Dr. Jorrit’s recent files that you uploaded to me left us with more questions than answers. While we know for a fact that the doctor had been inside Onyx, we don’t yet know the specifics of what he was doing. The client is eager for us to learn more about what exactly Jorrit’s up to, so I’m afraid you’re going to have to go back in.

I have a few ideas on how we might be able to use the facility’s systems to pinpoint Dr. Jorrit’s activities, though you’ll have to physically bring me the data this time so we can properly analyze it. First up, are the energy sensors in Engineering. They’re still active and sensitive enough to pick up any anomalous readings.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and retrieve the Energy Anomaly data and deliver it to [DESTINATION].

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler
values.description:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold 1 SCU cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you.

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of Titanium from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

values.title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Exclusive)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the exclusive mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Your priority is to disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces.

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission.

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

values.title: CDF ALERT: Xenothreat Ambush - Support Needed
values.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, XenoThreat forces started to ambush Naval convoy ships transporting vital supplies while en route to Jericho station at the Pyro Gateway in the Stanton System. The Navy has requested CDF forces to help recover these supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho.

The Navy has organized a community stipend to handle the distribution of payment. This will be distributed among all CDF volunteers at assigned intervals. An indicator will appear on your HUD to measure these payouts.

Please note that some of these supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.

Additionally, while not as volatile, the supplies of DynaFlex lost during the attack are still urgently needed by the Navy to complete their repairs of the Javelin and should be a priority for recovery.

Also, XenoThreat hostiles might still be in the area so be careful. CDF volunteers with combat experience are also urged to contribute by securing these areas from lingering XenoThreat forces.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.

values.title: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his lab notes to your mobiGlas journal once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a Reagent code from the Engineering wing and a Catalyst code from the Research wing.

Once you have those, head down to the Lab in Site-B and run the experiment so you can upload the results.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

values.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

values.title: Goods for the Getting
values.description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them?

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you.

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

values.title: XenoThreat = GoodLoot
values.description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat.

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting.

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight.

Stows out.

Hey,

So this is a little awkward for me to talk about, but it turns out that one of the people who passed away on that Covalex station disaster, Kyomi Santos, actually bequeathed me something in her will. I was surprised to hear it, but apparantly I'm now the proud owner of everything stored in box #173. The people at Covalex say I'll be able to get it when the station opens back up but ... this is the awkward part ... I kind of really need it right now. Normally I'd just wait, but I'm trying to start my own business (I make cakes in the shape of people's homeworlds) and the credits I get from selling it will really be a huge help. I've got a little bit stashed away now that I can use to pay for someone to deliver it from Gundo to [Destination] for me. I know the whole things a little bit irregular, but if there was any other way I wouldn't be asking.

Thanks for the help,

values.title: Defend Location and Deliver Confidential Materials
values.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at a derelict outpost. The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to [dropoff1] for payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to a derelict outpost.
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to [dropoff1|address].

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment.
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.

values.title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #1
values.description:
If travelling to different star systems around the Empire, helping those in need, and protecting our borders sounds like a rewarding career to you, then maybe you’re ready to become a pilot in the UEE Navy.

The overall demand for naval pilots has increased in recent years which means there’s now more opportunity than ever before. However, to become a Navy pilot, you need to go through specialist training and gain many hours of flight experience.

To give you a small taste of what life as a combat pilot would be like, Gilly’s Flight School has partnered with the UEE Navy to offer a unique opportunity to take a special Patrol Training course that will run you through three scenarios covering a basic patrol.

SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #1 – Scanning a Patrol Point

I believe that folks learn best by doing, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding out there. This is about throwing you into the deep end and giving you a chance to swim. You never know what you’re capable of until you’re given the chance.

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [ScripAmount] MG Scrip. Plus, completing all three will get you a special keepsake.

Can’t wait to see you out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

A client has hired the agency to look for a missing friend who has not been returning their comms and have been acting increasingly erratic. The client has shared all the information they possess on [TARGET] and we’ve been able to pinpoint their ship’s location.

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.

values.title: Orange Level Contract: Return the Favor
values.description:
Recently, a [TARGET] baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.

Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at [LOCATION] that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us?

It’ll be you against the [TARGET], other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.

Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

Briefing: There's a growing concern that Vanduul hunting parties are pushing further into Nyx. The first line of defense against this encroachment is increased patrols. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

values.title: End Nine Tails' Occupation at Orison
values.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, Nine Tails forces have seized control of several commercial platforms near Orison. Using an Identity Friend or Foe Inverter (IFFI), they have taken over the restricted air space surrounding the platforms and only Nine Tails affiliated ships can gain access to the area. This has severely hampered Crusader Security's initial attempts at retaking the platforms. As such, Crusader has requested that CDF forces assist in shutting down the inverter and eliminating all hostile presence. Any available CDF volunteers are encouraged to provide support.

Additional Intel:
* While the inverter is active and the airspace inaccessible, CDF has managed to gain control of a local shuttle system and route it to access Solanki Platform without the Nine Tails knowledge. Volunteers will need to head to the Crusader Industries Showroom on the Commercial Platform and get to the rooftop to find the shuttle that will travel to the occupied platforms.
* The IFFI is believed to be located in a locked storage container on a cargo barge docked at the central Admin Center.
* Access codes for the IFFI container are in the possession of the leader of the Nine Tails forces, Mendo Ren.
* Past experience with Mendo Ren indicates that he is unlikely to show his face and risk capture. However, if all his lieutenants are neutralized, we believe he will have no choice but to take command of the forces in person and provide us the opportunity to retrieve the codes from him.
* In addition to the shuttle system, Crusader Security has informed us that there are several vehicles on the platforms available for CDF to commandeer. These vehicles will be the only way of reaching the Admin Center. NOTE - If all of the vehicles within the restricted air space are destroyed before the inverter can be shut down, then there will be no way of reaching the cargo barge and the CDF will be forced to retreat.
* The platforms are protected by Nine Tails controlled Anti-Air weapons.

Please be aware that SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular [TARGET]. Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: QV Breaker Station BRK-304 Mining Rights (Shared)
values.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
values.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

values.title: Tactical Strike
values.description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.

We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

My gut says the pilot’s been ghosted. They knew how to handle a ship well, so the scavs that took them out must be decent. When you get my three packages back, take them to [DESTINATION] for me and I’ll wire you the creds.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.

See, for a smaller company like us, staying ahead of competition means that we need to offer our clients something they can't get elsewhere - discretion. At Red Wind, as long as you got the credits we'll take whatever to wherever. Understand?

If that sounds good to you, let's see how you do on this run -

values.title: Target at [LOCATION]
values.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [LOCATION] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TARGET] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TARGET] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid.

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

values.title: Protect Site and Procure Confidential Materials
values.description:
ATTN: Mercenaries with Cargo Handling Experience

Nine Tails are currently assaulting one of our facilities at a derelict outpost. As they just received a delivery of confidential materials, we don’t believe this is a coincidence. BlacJac needs someone to hurry to the location and secure these important boxes before the Nine Tails do. You are authorized to use lethal force against any who attempt to stop you.

As part of our standard security protocol, the confidential materials were integrated into another consignment and secured in the automated vault. You’ll need to find the relevant retrieval codes for the confidential materials and enter it at the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. Retrieval codes are stored locally on datapads and only given to high-ranking staff. Hopefully they’re alive to help you, but considering the complete comms blackout, we fear that’s not the case. There's a chance Nine Tails have already gotten their hands on the datapads.

Once you’ve gathered all the confidential materials, they will need to be delivered to [dropoff1|address]. Payment is contingent upon their delivery.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

values.title: Getting Our Gear Back
values.description:
If you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself. That's what they say, right? Wish I had the time for that, but I have a business to run.

Some of our goods have been mislaid and I need a contractor to put this right for me. Got some info that the guys at [LOCATION] ghosted one of my gang and got their hands on our gear. I need you to grab the stuff, deal with anyone at the location and take it to the drop-off at [DESTINATION] for me. Get it done and I'll sort out your payment.

-Twitch

values.title: Alliance Aid: Treatment Cargo Haul - Small Scale
values.description:
Hi,

We’ve joined the effort to help those affected by the Molina mold outbreak. There’s a small scale haul of urgently needed treatment waiting to be picked up from [LOCATION] and delivered to [DESTINATION]. Any chance you’re available?

All you’ll need is a ship that can fit 1 SCU cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to make moving the stuff easier on you.

Safe Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

values.description:
Hi,

This outbreak of Molina Mold really has folks on edge. Hauling requests for new vent filters is through the roof, even from places that weren’t using those cheap Gyson ones.

Anyways, I have one such haul here I was hoping you could knock out. It’s a small scale haul of filters waiting at [LOCATION] that needs to go to [DESTINATION]. You free to take care of it?

According to the haul specifics, the containers will be 1 SCU in size or smaller. Don’t forget to bring a handheld tractor beam along to help you move everything.

Appreciate you taking of this important run for us!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Secure [LOCATION] from Upstarts
values.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any friendly ships need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.

If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 3 Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

values.title: Red Level Contract: Ambush Attack Squad
values.description:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens.

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a [TARGET], was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by [LOCATION]. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support.

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of 12 MG Scrip for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

These assets are highly valuable, so need to keep those safe at all costs – though we know it’ll be no easy feat.

I cannot stress enough how dangerous these guys are, so I wouldn’t hesitate to bring backup to deal with them. If you and the assets make it out intact, we’re offering a well-earned 7 MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Best of luck,

Eugene Walton

values.description:

- Stows

Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.

A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club

values.title: Pilot in Distress

Lima Endicott

values.title: Back up needed at outpost

Stows out.

values.title: Cut Citizens For Prosperity Power

values.title: Finishing The Job
values.description:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.

Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at [LOCATION].

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.

• Access to combat equipment.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with extermination

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

values.title: Red Level Contract: Save Ships at [LOCATION]
values.description:
Ship support is needed at [LOCATION] immediately. Our client’s interests in the area are under fierce attack by outlaw forces. Looking for someone who can grab their gear, a few support ships they can trust, and deploy before it’s too late. Once you arrive, I’ll send any sitrep updates your way.

Don’t mess this up. These clients are paying for and expecting top tier protection. If anything goes wrong, we could lose this contract. That’s why we’ll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip if all goes down without a hitch.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: Reprisal Attack
values.description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

values.title: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
values.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF:
There's been another attack out at [LOCATION]. Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, retrieve the blackbox and deliver it [DESTINATION]. Make sure you bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet they're still in the area.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

values.title: Hunt Bounty: [TARGET]
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received a tip on the location of a high-profile bounty. Intel reports have tracked [TARGET] to [LOCATION]. We need a contractor heading in that direction on the double before the target vanishes. According to the latest reports, they were last seen near the [LOCATION].

Come prepared to use lethal force if [TARGET] resists apprehension.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Red Wind Seeking New Couriers
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Red Wind is excited to announce that we are looking to hire new couriers to help with deliveries across the ’verse. We pride ourselves on been a flexible company that’s eager to meet the needs of all clients, everywhere. We’ll ask no questions; if you want it there, we’ll get it there. If that sounds like you, we have an introductory contract to see if you’re the right fit.

We need a resilient new hire to head to [LOCATION], recover the package abandoned by a former employee, and finish the delivery.

PACKAGES TO RECOVER
· 1x [ITEM1]

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Deliver to [DESTINATION]

If you’re able to handle this contract we’d be delighted to send you more courier opportunities.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

values.title: Delivery of Abandoned Ling Cargo
values.description:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to [LOCATION] and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

values.title: Trainee Rank - Direct Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]

values.title: Trainee Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_SingleToMulti]

values.title: Grab ‘n’ go
values.description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to [LOCATION]. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a heavy-duty tractor beam on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

values.title: Sneaky Starfighter Ion
values.description: Starfighter Ion good ship, but it could be more sneak, yes? Surprise your not friends when you shoot them. I help with this for you. I need the right items and then I can give to you. Bring to me. Bye.

values.title: Shut Off Power at [LOCATION]
values.description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [LOCATION] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_MultiToSingle]

values.title: NEW HIRE: Locate Missing Person
values.description:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP38100
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Hockrow Agency is looking for new contractors with a strong stomach and familiarity with dangerous situations to handle the legwork of an active missing persons investigation.

Reports indicate that it is highly unlikely that you will encounter any hostiles.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Travel to [LOCATION], search for [TARGET], and confirm their status. If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Successful completion of this task will open up other employment opportunities within Hockrow Agency.

values.title: Headhunter Pilot Needs a Hand
values.description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [LOCATION]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

values.title: Security Contractor Reevaluation
values.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself.

In an effort to reevaluate your skills, microTech Protection Services would like you to assist in protecting [Location|Address] against hostile threats.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to [Location|Address].
• Help protect the site; using force as necessary.
• Avoid any friendly fire incidents.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

values.title: Primo Target
values.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TARGET] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TARGET] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [LOCATION], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

values.title: Tactical Strike
values.description:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.

We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

values.title: Hunt Some Heads
values.description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of 16 Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.

- Stows

values.title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Small Cargo Haul (Medical)
values.description:
Hey,

There's been an uptick in demand for medical supplies since the Molina mold outbreak started. That's why the medical team at [DESTINATION] is running low on a few essentials and can't wait for their regular restock. Any chance you're available to do a priority run there now?

Goods are ready and waiting at [LOCATION]. It's a small scale haul, but you'll still need a handheld tractor beam. Looks like the containers will be as big as 1 SCU in size.

Hope its a safe and smooth haul for you,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: Stop Deadly Ship Attack
values.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Despite our warnings, a client decided to fly to [LOCATION]. Unsurprisingly, they just dropped a rescue beacon in the area, so we’re looking for a contractor to get on site, assess the situation, and hopefully rescue the client.

We warned them that extremely dangerous and well-equipped outlaws often strike ships there. That’s exactly what I assume happened here, so make sure you plan accordingly.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

values.title: Trainee Rank - Direct Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]

values.title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
values.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [LOCATION] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans.

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Medium Cargo Haul (Filters)
values.description:
Hey,

There's a medium scale haul of new vent filters at [LOCATION] waiting to go to [DESTINATION]. You available to handle it?

The team at [DESTINATION] is obviously very anxious to get these new filters, and won't stop bugging me about this haul until I give them a delivery ETA. No wonder with how worried everyone is about this Molina mold outbreak. Should be an easy run. All that's needed is a ship that can hold containers 8 SCU in size or smaller, and a handheld tractor beam.

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

values.title: [Contractor|DestroyBladeTitle]
values.description: [Contractor|DestroyBladeDescription]

values.title: CDF ALERT: Attack on XenoThreat
values.description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for a final assault on the XenoThreat outlaw pack that have been plaguing Stanton System. The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

values.title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
values.description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life.

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet.

Go to [LOCATION] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

values.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
values.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [LOCATION] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Minor Repairs Needed: Chawla's Beach
values.description:
A nearby outpost of ours at [LOCATION] is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need three fuses replaced and if you could bring a salvaging tool with enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

values.title: Trainee Rank - Direct Small Cargo Haul
values.description: [Contractor|HaulCargo_AtoB]

values.title: Clear Claimjumpers
values.description:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary
LOCATION: [LagrangeLocation]
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*:
It was recently discovered that a Shubin mining claim has been illegally poached by a rogue miner. While the miner themselves seems to no longer be stealing ore from the site, they did leave behind an orbital sentry which is preventing us from reclaiming it thanks to its offensive capabilities.

We are looking for a mercenary willing to travel to [location] hunt down the sentry and destroy it in preparation for Shubin repossession of the site.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Overdrive Initative: Xenothreat Ambush - Support Needed
values.description:
Attention CDF volunteers, XenoThreat finally launched their attack against Jericho Station at the Pyro Gateway in Stanton.

The Navy has requested CDF forces to help combat XenoThreat forces in the area and/or recover supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho station.

The Navy has organized a community stipend to handle the distribution of payment. This will be distributed among all CDF volunteers at assigned intervals. An indicator will appear on your HUD to measure these payouts.

Please note that the supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

values.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ship Under Attack
values.description:
Foxwell is looking for an available combat pilot to provide immediate assistance to a [SHIP] under attack over by [LOCATION]. We have not identified the perpetrators in the attack, but have been assured it is a small force.

Please dispatch quickly and clear out all hostiles. We need the client to make it through this as they haven't paid us yet.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

values.title: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
values.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

Good luck and good speed, courier!

values.title: Senior Hauler Needed for Large Shipment
values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Just got off a comm with a client. They got cargo (32 SCU or smaller) at a few different locations ready to be taken over to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

I'd recommend taking a few minutes to plan your route before taking off. Might save you a bit of fuel. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

values.title: Moderate Repairs Needed: [LOCATION]
values.description:
Hello,

We've received word that a devastating storm hit [LOCATION] which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Red Wind is looking to bolster our roster of haulers. Need someone who can keep their wits about them and keep quiet. If you check those boxes, and have a ship that can handle 8 SCU cargo containers, then give this trial run a shot.

PICK UP
Freight elevator at [LOCATION].

DROP OFF
Freight elevator at [DESTINATION].

values.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to [DESTINATION].

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.

values.title: Rookie Rank - Small Cargo Haul
values.description:
Hi,

There’s a load of stims at [LOCATION] ready to be picked up from a freight elevator and delivered to a few spots. They will be packaged up in containers 4 SCU or smaller. Any chance you can knock this one out for me?

Doesn’t matter what order you drop them off.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Chase Hewitt

Covalex Shipping

values.title: Patrol Dangerous Outlaw Sector
values.description:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been increasingly riddled with outlaw attacks and we think that if we begin to actively patrol the area we can turn things around. We’d recommend gathering at least two wingmen to head out there in combat-ready ships and confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Now some red tape asshole is trying to tell me that I have to wait to get my stuff back. Yeah right. First you kill my brother and now you want me to be patient? The nerve of these corporate jillos. Forget that. Instead, I figured I'd hire someone to go to Gundo to get my stuff and take it to [Destination] for me. I mean, what the hell are they gonna do about it? Anyway, it's what my brother would have wanted. It's gonna be the box marked 156.

- Ed

values.description:

With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn 9 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

Looking for a contractor willing to hustle there, hide in the emission cloud, and then spring the trap when the time is right. There’s usually escort ships with the [TARGET]. Careful not to jump the gun and blow your cover. The element of surprise is crucial from what I’ve read.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 5 MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

values.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TARGET] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TARGET] was spotted flying around [LOCATION], so get there quick before they disappear again.

-Stows

values.description:

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

values.description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [LOCATION]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on Daymar and Aberdeen. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

values.title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #3
values.description:
Congrats on completing part two of this three-part course.

For your next and final lesson, you will learn how to assist a ship in distress just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol. They will be under simulated attack by our specially trained hostile pilots and it will be up to you to neutralize them as quickly and effectively as possible.

SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #3 – Ship in Distress

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [ScripAmount] MG Scrip and a special keepsake.

I know you’re going to do great out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

values.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
values.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

Before they cut out, they told me that the ships that attacked them weren’t your standard transporters. These assholes are rocking some serious weaponry. Bring a crew, get my shit, and take it to [DESTINATION]. This whole thing is such a mess that I’d be willing to fork out some extra creds if you can get this done.

-Twitch

values.description:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract.

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system.

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TargetName]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid.

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. We’re hoping to find motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a small scale haul of it for delivery to [DESTINATION].

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.
